_comment: Per-object grip force in raw FSR counts on the STRONGER jaw. Tuned Nov 22 from Pi logs: successful grips peaked ~15-27; glancing contacts ~78-99; idle ~6-10. Targets sit just above idle so a real squeeze stops early; max stays above glancing peaks so we don't OVER_FORCE. If jaws reach closed_angle first, contact_force in gripper.json still accepts the grip.
_names: egg = Pill bottle, cup = Squeeze bottle, block = Pills.
